getLastActionAt(address).details: Returns 0 for wallets with no recorded actions.

getLoanLimitBps(address).details: Returns 0 for Unranked. Delegates to ReputationMath.loanLimitBps().

getScore(address).details: Returns 0 for wallets with no recorded actions — never reverts.

getTierName(address).details: For events and frontend display only.         Prefer getTier() for on-chain conditional logic.

owner().details: Returns the address of the current owner.

proxiableUUID().details: Implementation of the ERC-1822 {proxiableUUID} function. This returns the storage slot used by the implementation. It is used to validate the implementation's compatibility when performing an upgrade. IMPORTANT: A proxy pointing at a proxiable contract should not be considered proxiable itself, because this risks bricking a proxy that upgrades to it, by delegating to itself until out of gas. Thus it is critical that this function revert if invoked through a proxy. This is guaranteed by the `notDelegated` modifier.

recordAction(address,uint8).details: CALLER RESTRICTION: only authorised callers (set via setAuthorizedCaller).         REENTRANCY: implementation must use ReentrancyGuard.         CEI ORDER: Checks → Effects (score, actionCount, lastActionAt) → Interact (token.issue).         Auto-issues a Soulbound Token on the wallet's first recorded action.

params.wallet: The wallet to attribute the action to. Must not be address(0).

renounceOwnership().details: Leaves the contract without owner. It will not be possible to call `onlyOwner` functions. Can only be called by the current owner. NOTE: Renouncing ownership will leave the contract without an owner, thereby disabling any functionality that is only available to the owner.

setAuthorizedCaller(address,bool).details: CALLER RESTRICTION: only owner.         Authorised callers are typically vault / protocol contracts.         Emits CallerAuthorized or CallerRevoked depending on `authorized`.

params.authorized: True to grant, false to revoke.
params.caller: Address to authorise or deauthorise. Must not be address(0).

transferOwnership(address).details: Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account (`newOwner`). Can only be called by the current owner.

upgradeToAndCall(address,bytes).details: Upgrade the implementation of the proxy to `newImplementation`, and subsequently execute the function call encoded in `data`. Calls {_authorizeUpgrade}. Emits an {Upgraded} event.

getActionCount(address).notice: Returns total actions recorded for `wallet` across all types.

getLastActionAt(address).notice: Returns the block timestamp of the wallet's most recent action.

getLoanLimitBps(address).notice: Returns the max undercollateralised loan limit (bps) for `wallet`.

getReputationToken().notice: Returns the address of the bound ReputationToken contract.

getScore(address).notice: Returns the current reputation score for `wallet`.

getTierName(address).notice: Returns the human-readable tier name for `wallet`.

getVotingMultiplier(address).notice: Returns the voting power multiplier (bps) for `wallet`.

initialize(address,address).notice: One-time initialiser — replaces constructor for UUPS proxy.

isAuthorized(address).notice: Returns true if `caller` is authorised to call recordAction().

recordAction(address,uint8).notice: Record an on-chain action for `wallet` and update its score.

setAuthorizedCaller(address,bool).notice: Grant or revoke authorisation for a caller to record actions.
